name: Danielle Guimond
bio: ER RN at Canton-Potsdam Hospital. JD first noticed her while working CPH security but did not pursue contact at the time. Facebook friend request July 2024, Snapchat November 2024, asked her to hang out late December 2024. Three visits before JD left for BCT on January 8, 2025. Warm text exchange during BCT that faded by February from attrition. She moved on by April 2025. She was also the nurse for JD's grandmother Norma Meyers, an occasional ER patient at CPH who passed away in late March 2025. JD unfollowed/removed her on most platforms in early 2026. Still Facebook friends.
